name: Crexi
positioning: A CRE marketplace that also runs the deal — listing, bidding, due diligence room and comps in one place.
description: Crexi combines a commercial listing marketplace with transaction tooling: offer management, an auction platform, a virtual deal room, and Crexi Intelligence for sales comparables, ownership records and lease data. It positions itself as the challenger to the incumbent CoStar and LoopNet pairing.
real_estate_use: A broker lists an asset, receives structured offers or runs a timed auction, and shares due-diligence documents through a permissioned data room instead of a shared drive link. Buyers use Crexi Intelligence to check what comparable assets traded for and who owns the building next door before committing to underwriting.
features: Commercial listing marketplace across asset classes
Structured offer submission and auction platform
Crexi Intelligence comparables, ownership and lease data
Broker CRM and buyer activity analytics
Marketing tools including flyers and email campaigns

use_cases.job: Run a competitive bid process on an asset with a controlled document room
Check sale comparables and ownership before underwriting an acquisition
